title: CMB lensing bandpower row
description: One binned lensing-potential bandpower from Planck 2018 VIII Table 1. Each row records the L bin range, the bin label, the estimator (TT temperature-only, MV minimum-variance combined T+E+B, or PP polarization-only), the conservative/aggressive range kind, the amplitude relative to the fiducial bandpower (fid_A_hat with 1-σ error), the fiducial bandpower in units of 10^7 L^2 (L+1)^2 C_L^{phi phi} / (2 pi), and the observed bandpower obtained as the product fid_A_hat * fiducial. Polarization-only inhomogeneous-filter variants share the same fiducial bandpowers as the homogeneous-filter PP rows.

L_bin_label.description: Stable identifier for this lensing-bandpower row (e.g. 'MV_L0008-0040_cons').

L_min.description: Inclusive lower edge of the L bin. Planck 2018 PR3 lensing uses L_min = 8 (lower-L bins are removed due to mean-field-subtraction sensitivity).

L_max.description: Inclusive upper edge of the L bin. Conservative range stops at L = 400; aggressive range extends to L = 2048.

estimator.description: Lensing-reconstruction estimator. TT = temperature-only quadratic estimator; MV = minimum-variance combination of T + E + B (Planck 2018 baseline); PP = polarization-only with homogeneous map filtering; PP_inhomogeneous = polarization-only with optimal inhomogeneous filtering (shares fiducial bandpowers with PP).

range_kind.description: Multipole range. 'conservative' covers 8 <= L <= 400 (recommended for parameter constraints). 'aggressive' covers 8 <= L <= 2048 (high-L bins fail a pair of consistency tests; use with caution per Planck 2018 VIII Sect. 4).

fid_A_hat.description: Amplitude of the bandpower relative to the FFP10 fiducial LambdaCDM model; A_hat = 1 corresponds to the fiducial. Listed in the 'fid_A_hat^{phi,X}' columns of Planck 2018 VIII Table 1 for each estimator X.

fid_A_hat_error.description: 1-sigma Gaussian uncertainty on fid_A_hat, as listed in Table 1.

fiducial_bandpower.description: Fiducial FFP10 LambdaCDM bandpower in units of 10^7 L^2 (L+1)^2 C_L^{phi phi} / (2 pi). Listed in the 'X-fid' columns of Table 1; values differ slightly between TT/MV/PP because each estimator uses approximate inverse-variance weighting that varies between reconstructions.

observed_bandpower.description: Observed bandpower in the same units as fiducial_bandpower, computed as fid_A_hat * fiducial_bandpower.

precision_flag.description: Per-row precision flag. PR3 lensing rows are 'high' (values from Table 1 verbatim).

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes (e.g. 'consistency-test marginal' for high-L aggressive bins).

source_doi.description: DOI of the cited Planck reference. Default 10.1051/0004-6361/201833886 (Planck 2018 VIII).

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional Planck release version, e.g. 'PR3' or 'PR3/R3.00'.

source_file.description: Optional PLA file source (e.g. 'Planck 2018 VIII Table 1' or 'COM_Lensing_4096_R3.00').
